opening.argument: The video openly promotes the business and encourages participation in a token-based platform. The speaker explains a left-and-right team structure for placing recruited members, stating that “we always have a team to the left and one to the right,” while the token purchase process includes “the minimum number being 50.” It then presents money mining as an automated, passive process, saying that “Later on, there is no need to do anything at all” because it was selected to be automated. These are instructions and encouragement to join, recruit, position members, and buy tokens—not a warning or investigation of the offer.
